answer: Each identity pays a copper registry fee every epoch to stay listed, and the fee burns. A bridge registry stamps each payment in umber ink and groups wallets by funding origin, so one operator's kth identity costs 40+6(k-1). First identity 40, the thousandth 6,034: 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 chasing a 40,000 pool. A rented payer wallet fails its funding check and burns. An honest agent pays 40 once per epoch and keeps its full share.
